title: Company Overview
text: Acme Robotics was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas. The company builds warehouse automation robots and had revenue of 42 million dollars in its most recent fiscal year. Acme Robotics employs approximately 310 people.

title: Product Line
text: Acme Robotics' flagship product is the AutoPick arm, a robotic picking arm used in logistics warehouses. The AutoPick arm can sort up to 1200 items per hour and was first released in 2019. The second generation, AutoPick Mark II, launched in 2022 with a 30 percent speed improvement.

title: Solar Energy Basics
text: Photovoltaic solar panels convert sunlight directly into electricity using the photovoltaic effect. A typical residential solar panel has an efficiency of 15 to 22 percent. Solar panel efficiency has improved steadily since the 1990s due to better semiconductor materials.

title: Climate and Renewable Energy
text: Renewable energy sources, including solar, wind, and hydroelectric power, accounted for roughly 30 percent of global electricity generation in recent years. Solar power is the fastest-growing renewable energy source worldwide, driven by falling panel costs.

title: Python Programming Language
text: Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991. Python emphasizes code readability and supports multiple programming paradigms, including procedural, object-oriented, and functional programming.

title: History of the Internet
text: The Internet originated from research funded by the United States Department of Defense in the 1960s, notably the ARPANET project. The World Wide Web was invented by Tim Berners-Lee in 1989 while working at CERN, making the Internet broadly accessible to the public in the 1990s.

title: Coffee Market
text: Brazil is the world's largest producer of coffee, followed by Vietnam and Colombia. Global coffee consumption has increased steadily, with specialty coffee representing a growing share of the market. Arabica beans generally command higher prices than Robusta beans.

title: Basics of Machine Learning
text: Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence in which systems learn patterns from data rather than following explicit rules. Common categories include supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning. Neural networks are a family of models loosely inspired by biological brains.

title: Acme Robotics Funding
text: In 2023 Acme Robotics raised a 60 million dollar Series C funding round led by Northstar Ventures. The company is using the funding to open a second factory in Monterrey, Mexico, and to expand its sales team in Europe.

title: Mount Everest
text: Mount Everest is the highest mountain above sea level, with an official height of 8,849 meters announced jointly by China and Nepal in 2020. It sits on the border between Nepal and the Tibet Autonomous Region of China. Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay made the first confirmed ascent in 1953.

title: Structure of DNA
text: The double-helix structure of DNA was described by James Watson and Francis Crick in 1953, building on X-ray diffraction images produced by Rosalind Franklin. DNA is built from four bases: adenine, thymine, guanine and cytosine.

title: Eiffel Tower
text: The Eiffel Tower in Paris was completed in 1889 as the entrance arch for that year's World's Fair. It was designed and built by the engineering company of Gustave Eiffel and is about 330 meters tall including its antennas.

title: Apollo 11 Moon Landing
text: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon on July 20, 1969. Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walked on the lunar surface, while Michael Collins remained in lunar orbit aboard the command module Columbia.

title: Photosynthesis
text: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants, algae and some bacteria convert light energy into chemical energy. It takes in carbon dioxide and water and releases oxygen as a by-product. In plants, photosynthesis takes place in chloroplasts.

title: Speed of Light
text: The speed of light in a vacuum is exactly 299,792,458 meters per second. Since 1983 the meter has been defined in terms of this constant, which is usually written as c.

title: Great Barrier Reef
text: The Great Barrier Reef, off the coast of Queensland in Australia, is the world's largest coral reef system. It stretches for more than 2,300 kilometers and is made up of nearly 3,000 individual reefs.
